dedupe_keys.name: times sweden techno economic databases for heat generation and fuel production technologies

description: These two databases give techno-economic data for heat and power technologies and for fuel production technologies, compiled from the literature and formatted as SubRES workbooks for TIMES energy system models. They were published on Zenodo in March 2022 (version 1.0) by Erik Sandberg for the TIMES-Sweden model, with funding from the Swedish Energy Agency (project 49627-1), and are part of the IEA ETSAP SubRES effort to make techno-economic data more accessible. The heat generation database focuses on heat generation in industry and district heating; the fuel production database covers stand-alone plants, plants co-producing district heat and plants supplying heat to industry. They are meant to be used with the TIMES-Sweden industry database. Coverage is Sweden, though the authors note the data can be applied to other regions. Files are Excel workbooks with transformation files and version histories, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: values come from the literature as of 2022, and the format targets TIMES users. Simulation uses are technology parameters for energy system optimisation of district heating, industry heat and fuel supply. Related records: model-times-ireland-model is another TIMES model.
